script: The biggest fish in the world eats some of the smallest food in the sea. Whale sharks are the largest fish alive, often 12 meters long or more. They swim with their huge mouths open, filtering plankton and small fish from the water. Despite their size, they are gentle and not a danger to swimmers. Every whale shark has its own pattern of white spots. Researchers identify them with a pattern-matching method first made for mapping stars. Follow Pixel Abyss for more strange facts from the deep.
